description: This file provides utility functions and enums for managing microphone refresh, device observation, and voice wake bindings within a macOS SwiftUI application. It includes methods for scheduling refresh tasks, selecting microphone names from device lists, and binding voice wake enablement status.

methods.name: startObserver
methods.description: Starts observing an audio input device and triggers a refresh callback when the device changes.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules a refresh action to be executed after a delay, cancelling any previous scheduled task.

methods.name: selectedMicName
methods.description: Selects the microphone name from a list of devices given a selected ID.

methods.name: voiceWakeBinding
methods.description: Creates a SwiftUI binding for the voice wake feature based on the application state.
